algolia.name: AOC - 15.6" Widescreen Flat-Panel USB-Powered Portable LED Monitor - Piano Black
algolia.description: View crisp, vibrant images with this AOC E1649FWU 15.6" flat-panel LED monitor that features 200 cd/m² brightness and a 500:1 contrast ratio for arresting visuals. The USB interface allows a quick connection without a power cord.
